paragraphs: Lytx sells video safety and telematics products to fleets. The platform identifies distracted, drowsy, and risky driving behaviors before collisions. Alerts and coaching workflows are offered to reduce incidents and insurance costs. The company states that it has helped more than 7,000 organizations over more than 27 years.

A separate line covers Department of Transportation compliance, including electronic logging devices, hours of service records, driver vehicle inspection reports, and driver qualification file audits. The Surfsight line is sold to fleet technology providers that build video safety into their own product portfolios.
Customer references on these pages include a safety manager at Pierce Transit. Another reference comes from a safety manager at A.D. Transport Express.

quote.text: Safety is core. Data informs. Video transforms.
